label: Sample (BK-12): made-up answers for the made-up Study permit family's case (a student, the spouse, a child), saved and confirmed by api/src/sample-case.ts from samples/sample-cases.json. Never a client, never submitted. No value here is an IRCC value. Unconfirmed: expert. Legal: Unconfirmed: no counsel.
source: Made up for BK-12 (P-448, P-449: a pathway's Sample case is chosen in data). Only questions the Study permit's release asks are answered (an answer it does not ask is refused in words by the loader). BK-13 step 1 (P-449, P-481 S6): widened so the Study permit's forms can be written: every made-up answer the release asks of a single student of 20 studying outside Québec, with no representative-only release and no custodian. Option values are the release's own lists (for example IMM 1294's "F Female"). BK-13 step 2 (13 Nov): the walk's family, a married student of 30, the spouse (31, an open work permit) and a child of 9 who will not study (a visitor), each answered only where the release asks it of that person.

none_apply.why: Sample: the family has no other names and no post-secondary education to list (IMM 1294 asks only post-secondary education); the spouse has had no job in the period IMM 1295 asks about and has lived only in the country of citizenship. A person with a job row (the student, the child's school) keeps it: "none apply" goes only on a person's empty group.
